scope: Aggregate historical experiment/evaluation evidence only; no raw OOF arrays, per-question cases or prediction contents. Original-path hashes identify sources before consolidation. Some original experiment paths are intentionally no longer distributed. The submitted artefact is verifier-v35; the v1 records below are historical.

selection_disclosure.current_retention_basis: Retrospective highest already-known official public-test aggregate score, by explicit user choice after experiments. This is not validation-only final selection or a fresh blind test.
selection_disclosure.historical_round_selection: v1/v2 selected with validation; v3-v7 used locked grouped train CV and post-lock validation/gates where eligible. Historical public-test outcomes had already been seen during continued development.
selection_disclosure.course_constraint: Guide requires train-only fitting, validation development/selection, and test references for final scoring/reproduction only. Current retrospective choice uses test feedback for final model retention; no eligibility certification is claimed.
selection_disclosure.consolidation_reproduction: One train-only fixed-alpha coefficient reproduction check; no new parameter search or test evaluation.

metric_order.contested: At least two distinct valid official parsed answers

final_method.pair_definition: One valid within-question correct-minus-wrong pair, each once
final_method.standardization: Population mean/std of all original training candidates; std<1e-12 becomes1; differences divide by scale
final_method.inference: Highest score among officially parsable candidates; first index on score tie; all-invalid fallback0
final_method.randomness: No stochastic fitting or initialization; no seed applies
